options.jaymospowers.blood.tooltip: How much blood you see: drops thrown by hits, how long pools and stains stay, and how many stains are shown at once. Off shows no blood or gore at all. Others can still track the trails and stains.
options.jaymospowers.gore.tooltip: Light: a little blood, little gore. Cinematic: normal blood, some gore. Brutal: heavy blood and the most gore. Sets the Blood button above.
options.jaymospowers.streamer_safe.toolt: Blood draws as grey dust, severed parts and gibs are not drawn, bodies stay whole and wound marks are hidden.
